description: Update a task in the configured Mindwtr backend.

anyOf.description: Area ID (only used when the task has no projectId)

areaId.description: Area ID (only used when the task has no projectId)

id.description: Attachment id. Omit to add a new link; pass an existing link's id to update it in place.

kind.description: Only "link" is accepted here. File attachments carry bytes this interface cannot transport.

title.description: Label shown in the app. Defaults to the last path segment of the uri.

uri.description: What the app opens: https://…, obsidian://…, file://… or a plain path.

attachments.description: The complete list of link attachments the item should have. Links not listed are removed; file attachments are never touched. Pass null or [] to remove every link.

anyOf.description: Manual ordering within a Board status column

boardOrder.description: Manual ordering within a Board status column

anyOf.description: Cancellation time in ISO format; archives the task without completion or another recurrence

cancelledAt.description: Cancellation time in ISO format; archives the task without completion or another recurrence

anyOf.description: Minutes before an explicit due time; 0 = off, maximum one week

dueReminderLeadMinutes.description: Minutes before an explicit due time; 0 = off, maximum one week

anyOf.description: Manual ordering within a sequential project

order.description: Manual ordering within a sequential project

anyOf.description: How many times dueDate has been pushed later

pushCount.description: How many times dueDate has been pushed later

recurrence.description: Recurrence object or RFC 5545 RRULE string; null clears it

anyOf.description: Offset from dueDate that recomputes startTime when dueDate changes

relativeStartOffset.description: Offset from dueDate that recomputes startTime when dueDate changes

reminderPolicy.description: Inherit the global task reminder default, explicitly send, or skip start/due reminders

anyOf.description: Repeat the due-time reminder every N minutes (presets 5|10|15|30|60); 0/absent = off

repeatReminderMinutes.description: Repeat the due-time reminder every N minutes (presets 5|10|15|30|60); 0/absent = off

showFutureRecurrence.description: Calendar-only preview of the next recurrence

anyOf.description: Minutes before an explicit start time; 0 = off, maximum one hour

startReminderLeadMinutes.description: Minutes before an explicit start time; 0 = off, maximum one hour

suppressMindwtrReminders.description: Skip Mindwtr start/due reminders for this task

anyOf.description: Total minutes worked on the task

timeSpentMinutes.description: Total minutes worked on the task

anyOf.description: Full per-view section assignment map. Resolve IDs with mindwtr_list_view_sections. Replaces the entire map; {} clears all assignments.

viewSectionIds.description: Full per-view section assignment map. Resolve IDs with mindwtr_list_view_sections. Replaces the entire map; {} clears all assignments.

name: mindwtr_update_task
